text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding argo-52k-int3 (int3 quant). Prefills start corrupting past ~50k tokens; small repro attached.
zoe: is this warm-prefill vs in-flight again?
maya: Likely. Repro: single ~52k token prompt then continue; after ~50k generation hallucinates earlier context (ghost tokens).
liam: paste kv index snippet?
maya: log: [kv] shard=3 prefill_len=51996 primed_keys=51996; index_map[51995]=51994; index_map[51996]=0 <-- wrap; generation_offset=51996
zoe: index_map[...] = 0 looks like a fencepost wrap, maybe rot_pos packing overflow.
rafael: argo uses phase-scaling (pos_scale=1.0). Works at 48k, breaks at ~50k.
jen: tried pos_scale=1.0001 — pushes fail a bit; suggests boundary off-by-one.
liam: suspect circular buffer calc: block_size * shard_count off-by-one when token_count % block_size == 0.
zoe: can we instrument kv_write to log wrap events?
maya: running canary quant-run-112 with INSTRUMENT_KV=1.
ops-bot: Deploy started: canary/quant-run-112 by maya
zoe: tracer shows kv_write at token 51996 memcopy to offset 0x0. modulus collapse?
rafael: likely integer cast or stride/padding bug from int3 packing.
jen: i can PR a clamp and assert(token_index < buffer_len) gated by build flag.
liam: add metric kv_wrap_events when index_map[x] < index_map[x-1].
jen: PR https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/9654 adds clamp, telemetry, and unit test.
ops-bot: Build success: image redwood/serving:canary-9654
maya: with clamp (assert off) we still saw wraps at tokens 51996, 52000, 52008.
liam: multiple wraps => oscillation; maybe prefill vs streaming race with continuous batching.
zoe: disabling continuous batching removed repro in one run.
rafael: points at batching coalescer ordering race.
jen: mitigation options: atomic reserve+write (lock) or seq-based offsets per-shard. locks hurt throughput.
liam: per-shard seq numbers look best.
zoe: short-term: disable continuous batching for argo-52k-int3 in canaries. long-term: seq-based indexing + telemetry and fuzzbench at 51k/52k/65k.
maya: opening infra flip; will update when regression done. TL;DR: root cause likely batching race combined with int3 packing + ring off-by-one. PR landed, disabling batching as mitigation, follow-up seq indexing.
